serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceAngry
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Yeah, you better run! Sinners!
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceNeutral
You: You saved my ass, thanks.
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceHappy
Ecclesiasticalot FF: No, you saved mine. You have my gratitude. 
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceNeutral
You: How did they catch you anyway? Seeing how you took out that guy with a taser or something… aren’t you loaded with weapons?
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceAngry
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Who told you that?! {{wi}}Nevermind. I have some idea…
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceNeutral
Ecclesiasticalot FF: They got lucky. One of them was lying in wait behind a corner and tripped me. Then they put me upside down inside a trash can and… you know the rest.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I could get away anytime I wanted, really, but I would have to activate my lethal weapons system and the aftermath of that would be unfavourable to these men and a lot of paperwork for me.
You: Good to know…
…to never piss him off. Who knows what he would do if they really started opening him up with a screwdriver…{{wi}} Self defence is a hell of an excuse.
You: Anyway, where’s that hobo that helped you out?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: He should be here any minute. I’m very fast on my wheels after all.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Here he comes.
